lines.text: Hi! I'm Lumi, your little firefly.
Welcome to Inner Breeze, your guide to a calmer, stronger life.
Start the day with your breath. Guided rounds, box breathing, or your own rhythm.
Sit in stillness, with a gentle bell to keep you company.
Flow through the Sun Salutation, pose by pose.
Learn Tai Chi, the gentle martial art. All twenty-four moves, one step at a time.
Build good habits, and watch every streak grow.
Keep your plans in Lists, and your thoughts in your Diary.
And whenever you need me, just ask.
Inner Breeze. Free, private, and made for you.
